name: NVIDIA RTX 4000 Ada xmu component profile v1

operator_overhead_seconds.policy: Disabled because this adapter reports only analytical operator work and does not model host launch, runtime dispatch, or opaque kernel overhead.

assumptions_not_hardware_verified.frequency_Hz: 2.175 GHz is the vendor boost-clock basis implied by 26.7 TFLOPS FP32 across 48 SMs with 128 CUDA cores per SM and FMA counted as two FLOPs; it is a profile reference clock, not a per-run observed clock.
assumptions_not_hardware_verified.l2_capacity_MB: 40 MiB observed through cudaDevAttrL2CacheSize on GPU-18ace299-5348-e6e4-d48c-1ee5a602859b.
assumptions_not_hardware_verified.l2_bandwidth_per_cycle_byte: 1920 B/cycle, scaled from the LLMCompass GA100 template by 48/128 SMs
assumptions_not_hardware_verified.tensor_and_vector_throughput: Tensor: 4x 16x16 FP16/BF16 MAC arrays per SM at 2.175 GHz gives 213.81 TFLOPS dense. Vector: 4x32 FP32 lanes, 2 FLOPs/lane/cycle gives 26.73 TFLOPS. Kernel efficiency is uncalibrated.
assumptions_not_hardware_verified.gddr6_topology: 160-bit bus and 9001 MHz memory clock observed through CUDA device attributes. Ten logical 16-bit channels at 18.002 Gbps/pin give a 360.04 GB/s physical-link peak.

calibration_status.prohibited_claim: This component profile is not a validated Ada microarchitecture, kernel-efficiency, cache-behavior, or native GDDR6 timing model.
